nodes.title: GAME STATE MAP
code:
; GAME STATE MAP
; Every variable the game uses, one page at $C000. The other code
; blocks use these names; change an address here and they follow.
; BootTitle clears $C000-$C0FD for every new game.

PLAYER_XL   = $C000   ; ship X, low byte (sprite coordinates)
PLAYER_XH   = $C001   ; ship X, ninth bit (0 or 1)
PLAYER_Y    = $C002   ; ship Y
SHIP_STEP   = $C003   ; pixels the ship moves this frame
SHIP_TILT   = $C004   ; 0 level, 1 climbing, 2 diving
PLAYER_BOOM = $C005   ; ship explosion timer, 0 = flying
INVULN      = $C006   ; frames of safety left (respawn / shield)
LIVES       = $C007   ; ships left
FIRE_LATCH  = $C008   ; 1 while fire is held (tap-fire mode)
KEY_LATCH   = $C009   ; 1 while the power key is held
ANIM        = $C00A   ; counts frames, drives every animation
SCROLL_TICK = $C00B   ; counts frames for the slow scroll
SCORE1      = $C00C   ; score: hundreds + thousands (BCD)
SCORE2      = $C00D   ; score: 10 thousands + 100 thousands (BCD)
WAVE_IDX    = $C00E   ; next WAVE_SCRIPT record, 0-7
WAVE_LEFT   = $C00F   ; enemies of this wave still to launch
WAVE_TIMER  = $C010   ; frames until the next launch
WAVE_PATH   = $C011   ; this wave: flight path
WAVE_Y      = $C012   ; this wave: start height
WAVE_GAP    = $C013   ; this wave: frames between enemies
WAVE_FRAME  = $C014   ; this wave: first ACTORS frame
WAVE_COL    = $C015   ; this wave: sprite colour
EN_ON       = $C016   ; enemy slot 0-2 flying (3 bytes)
EN_XL       = $C019   ; enemy X low byte (3 bytes)
EN_XH       = $C01C   ; enemy X ninth bit (3 bytes)
EN_Y        = $C01F   ; enemy Y (3 bytes)
EN_BASEY    = $C022   ; enemy start Y (paths swing round it) (3 bytes)
EN_PATH     = $C025   ; enemy flight path 0-3 (3 bytes)
EN_PHASE    = $C028   ; enemy frames since launch (3 bytes)
EN_FRAME    = $C02B   ; enemy first ACTORS frame (3 bytes)
EN_COL      = $C02E   ; enemy colour (3 bytes)
EN_BOOM     = $C031   ; enemy explosion timer (3 bytes)
EN_LAST     = $C034   ; 1 = last of its wave, carries a capsule (3 bytes)
SHOT_ON     = $C037   ; main shot / laser flying
SHOT_XL     = $C038
SHOT_XH     = $C039
SHOT_Y      = $C03A
DBL_ON      = $C03B   ; DOUBLE shot flying
DBL_XL      = $C03C
DBL_XH      = $C03D
DBL_Y       = $C03E
MSL_ON      = $C03F   ; MISSILE flying
MSL_XL      = $C040
MSL_XH      = $C041
MSL_Y       = $C042
OPT_XL      = $C043   ; OPTION position
OPT_XH      = $C044
OPT_Y       = $C045
CAP_ON      = $C046   ; a capsule is out
CAP_SLOT    = $C047   ; enemy slot whose sprite it borrows
CAP_XL      = $C048
CAP_XH      = $C049
CAP_Y       = $C04A
METER       = $C04B   ; lit power meter slot, 0 = none, 1-6
POWERS      = $C04C   ; owned powers, one byte per meter slot: (6 bytes)
SPEEDUPS    = $C04C   ;   SPEED: speed-ups taken
HAS_MISSILE = $C04D   ;   MISSILE owned
HAS_DOUBLE  = $C04E   ;   DOUBLE owned
HAS_LASER   = $C04F   ;   LASER owned
HAS_OPTION  = $C050   ;   OPTION owned
SHIELD      = $C051   ;   SHIELD: hits left
TRAIL_POS   = $C052   ; newest entry of the OPTION trail
PROBE_XL    = $C053   ; ProbeChar input point
PROBE_XH    = $C054
PROBE_Y     = $C055
PROBE_COL   = $C056   ; ProbeChar scratch
PROBE_CHAR  = $C057
BOX_XL      = $C058   ; BoxTest first sprite
BOX_XH      = $C059
BOX_Y       = $C05A
BOX_W       = $C05B   ; BoxTest hit distance X
BOX_H       = $C05C   ; BoxTest hit distance Y
TGT_XL      = $C05D   ; BoxTest second sprite
TGT_XH      = $C05E
TGT_Y       = $C05F
D_XL        = $C060   ; PutSprite inputs
D_XH        = $C061
D_Y         = $C062
D_PTR       = $C063
D_COL       = $C064
SPR_ON      = $C065   ; $D015 being built
SPR_MSB     = $C066   ; $D010 being built
T0          = $C067   ; scratch
T1          = $C068
T2          = $C069

; OPTION trail: 32 remembered ship positions
TRAIL_XL    = $C080
TRAIL_XH    = $C0A0
TRAIL_Y     = $C0C0

; High score - outside the cleared range so it survives a game over
HI1         = $C0FE   ; hundreds + thousands (BCD)
HI2         = $C0FF   ; 10 thousands + 100 thousands (BCD)

nodes.title: READ ME
code:
SHMUP H - READ ME
A sideways shooter in the
style of Konami's Nemesis.
The world scrolls left; you
fly right.

Each box is one job of the
game. The heading comment
says what it does, the
yellow arrows point at the
nodes that matter.

ASSETS (all editable):
TILES     charset + tags
WORLD     the level map
ACTORS    every sprite
FRONT_END title picture
STATUS    the HUD
WAVE_SCRIPT enemy waves
SINE_PATH   sine swing
MUSIC_AND_SFX title tune
GAME_SFX  sound effects

PANELS hold the settings
(F9 = Creator view):
SCREEN, SCROLL, SHIP,
POWER METER, ENEMIES,
WEAPONS, RULES, COLOURS
and HUD.

PLAY: joystick port 2.
Shoot the last enemy of a
wave for a capsule; SPACE
buys the lit power.

nodes.title: STARTUP
code:
STARTUP
The spine starts at SYSTEM
INIT, banks BASIC out and
jumps to the title. The two
raster IRQs that pin the HUD
are set up from here too.

nodes.title: BOOT + HUD SPLIT
code:
; STARTUP - MAIN SPINE - BOOT + HUD SPLIT
; State: HI1 HI2
;
; Bank BASIC out, clear the high score (power-on RAM is random),
; then straight to the title screen.
LDA #$36
STA $01
LDA #$00
STA HI1
STA HI2
JMP BootTitle

; InstallHudSplit - called once per game from GAME SETUP.
; Stops the CIA timer IRQs, points NMI at a bare RTI and banks
; out the KERNAL ($01 = $35). The HUD RASTER HANDLER macro below
; finishes the job by installing the two raster IRQs.
InstallHudSplit:
SEI
LDA #$7F
STA $DC0D
STA $DD0D
LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D
LDA #<HudNmi
STA $FFFA
LDA #>HudNmi
STA $FFFB
LDA #$1B
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
LDA #$35
STA $01

nodes.title: GAME STATE MAP
code:
GAME STATE MAP
Every variable has a name
here, one page at $C000.
Open it to see what each
byte means - the rest of
the code only uses names.

nodes.title: Line 32: HUD rows, hires,
code:
Line 32: HUD rows, hires,
no scroll (HudFixed).
Line 69: the playfield,
multicolour and scrolled
(HudPlayfield).

nodes.title: BOOT / TITLE
code:
BOOT / TITLE
Show the FRONT_END bitmap,
play the title tune, wait
for fire. Game over comes
back here too.

nodes.title: BOOT TITLE
code:
; BOOT / TITLE - BOOT TITLE
;
; BootTitle - also where a game over comes back to.
BootTitle:
SEI
CLD
LDX #$FF         ; fresh stack: a game over jumps here mid-call
TXS
LDA #$36
.byte $8D,$01,$00 ; STA $0001 (absolute, as SHMUP V)
LDA #$00
STA $D01A        ; no raster IRQs on the title
STA $D015        ; no sprites
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
; Clear GAME STATE ($C000-$C0FD). $C0FE/$C0FF keep the high score.
LDA #$00
LDX #$00
ClearState:
STA $C000,X
INX
CPX #$FE
BNE ClearState
; Port 2 as input, keyboard rows released.
LDA #$00
STA $DC02
LDA #$FF
STA $DC00

nodes.title: TITLE LOOP
code:
; BOOT / TITLE - TITLE LOOP
;
; Wait for fire to be pressed, then released, then start.
TitleLoop:
JSR TitleFrame
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BNE TitleLoop
TitleRelease:
JSR TitleFrame
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TitleRelease
JMP SetupGame

; One title frame: wait for the border, play the tune.
TitleFrame:

nodes.title: ASSET: MUSIC_AND_SFX
code:
ASSET: MUSIC_AND_SFX
The title tune. Open it in
the Music Maker: patterns
LEAD A/B and BASS A/B,
song TITLE THEME.

nodes.title: ASSET: FRONT_END
code:
ASSET: FRONT_END
The title picture, a hires
bitmap at $4000. Paint it
in the bitmap editor.

nodes.title: GAME SETUP
code:
GAME SETUP
Screen mode and charset,
the scrolling WORLD, the
sprites and the HUD. Then
a new game starts.

nodes.title: NEW GAME
code:
; GAME SETUP - NEW GAME
; State: LIVES SCORE1 SCORE2 WAVE_IDX WAVE_LEFT WAVE_TIMER
;
; A fresh game: ships, score, first wave, then into the loop.
START_LIVES = 3

; Every sprite hires, in front of the scenery, not expanded.
LDA #$00
STA $D01B
STA $D01C
STA $D017
STA $D01D
LDA #START_LIVES
STA LIVES
LDA #$00
STA SCORE1
STA SCORE2
STA WAVE_IDX
STA WAVE_LEFT
LDA #$40
STA WAVE_TIMER
JSR ResetActors
JSR DrawActors
JSR InstallHudSplit
JMP GameLoop

nodes.title: ASSET: TILES
code:
ASSET: TILES
The charset: font (32-90)
and the terrain (96-113).
Tags: T1 = rock (wall),
T2 = hatch (target).
Right-click a char to tag.

nodes.title: ASSET: WORLD
code:
ASSET: WORLD
The level: 2x2 stamps,
116 x 11. Paint it in the
tileset editor. The last
20 columns must repeat
the first 20 - that is
where the level loops
(LOOP_COL, FRAME LOOP).

nodes.title: ASSET: ACTORS
code:
ASSET: ACTORS
24 sprite frames, $A0 up:
0-3 ship, 4 shot, 5 laser,
6 double, 7 missile,
8-9 option, 10-17 enemies
(in pairs), 18-19 capsule,
20-23 explosion.

nodes.title: The sprites only get their
code:
The sprites only get their
start frame here - every
frame DrawActors (SPRITE
DRAW) sets position, frame
and colour.

nodes.title: ASSET: STATUS
code:
ASSET: STATUS
The HUD layout, rows 0-2.
Status (HUD VALUES) fills
in the numbers and the
meter colours.

nodes.title: FRAME LOOP
code:
FRAME LOOP
Game logic once a frame,
then wait for the border
to draw the sprites and
scroll the world.

nodes.title: GAME LOOP
code:
; FRAME LOOP - GAME LOOP
;
; One pass = one frame. All the game logic runs here, while the
; screen is still being drawn; drawing and scrolling wait for the
; bottom border (FRAME SYNC below).
GameLoop:
JSR SfxTick
JSR Effects
JSR Input
JSR PowerKey
JSR Enemy
JSR Weapons
JSR OptionMove
JSR Hits
JSR Capsule
JSR Status

nodes.title: DRAW + SCROLL
code:
; FRAME LOOP - DRAW + SCROLL
; State: SCROLL_TICK CAP_XL CAP_XH
;
; In the border: place the sprites, then scroll the world.
; Scroll speed - on the SCROLL panel.
SCROLL_SPEED = 1   ; 0 slow (1 pixel every 2 frames), 1 normal, 2 fast

JSR DrawActors
.IF SCROLL_SPEED == 0
INC SCROLL_TICK
LDA SCROLL_TICK
AND #$01
BEQ ScrollDone
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
.IF SCROLL_SPEED >= 1
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
.IF SCROLL_SPEED >= 2
JSR ScrollStep
.ENDIF
ScrollDone:
JMP GameLoop

; ScrollStep - the world moves one pixel left.
; MSC_R moves the WORLD SCROLLER camera right, MSC_Update finishes a
; coarse (whole char) step. $60 is the camera's map column. The
; WORLD map's last 40 columns repeat its first 40, so at LOOP_COL
; the camera can jump back to column 0 without the screen changing.
LOOP_COL = 192
ScrollStep:
JSR MSC_R
JSR MSC_Update
LDA $60
CMP #LOOP_COL
BCC ScrollCapsule
LDA #$00
STA $60
; A capsule sits in the world, so it drifts left with it.
ScrollCapsule:
LDA CAP_XL
BNE ScrollCapLo
DEC CAP_XH
ScrollCapLo:
DEC CAP_XL
RTS

nodes.title: Every job of the game is
code:
Every job of the game is
one JSR here. Comment one
out to switch it off while
you work on another.
nodes.custom_title: Every job of the game is

nodes.title: The world moves left, so
code:
The world moves left, so
the camera moves RIGHT:
JSR MSC_R from the WORLD
SCROLLER. At LOOP_COL it
jumps back to column 0.

nodes.title: RESPAWN
code:
RESPAWN
A fresh ship on the left,
weapons and enemies
cleared, a moment of
safety.

nodes.title: RESET ACTORS
code:
; RESPAWN - RESET ACTORS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM
;        INVULN WAVE_LEFT WAVE_TIMER EN_ON EN_BOOM SHOT_ON
;        DBL_ON MSL_ON CAP_ON METER POWERS TRAIL_XL TRAIL_XH
;        TRAIL_Y
;
; ResetActors - a new ship at the left of the screen.
; On the SHIP panel:
KEEP_POWERS = 0     ; 0 = a lost ship loses its power-ups (Nemesis rules)
RESPAWN_SAFE = 100  ; frames the new ship cannot be hit

ResetActors:
LDA #$40
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
LDA #$90
STA PLAYER_Y
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_BOOM
STA SHIP_TILT
STA SHOT_ON
STA DBL_ON
STA MSL_ON
STA CAP_ON
STA WAVE_LEFT    ; abandon the wave that was flying
.IF KEEP_POWERS == 0
STA METER
LDX #$05
ClearPowers:
STA POWERS,X
DEX
BPL ClearPowers
.ENDIF
LDX #$02
ClearEnemies:
STA EN_ON,X
STA EN_BOOM,X
DEX
BPL ClearEnemies
LDA #$60
STA WAVE_TIMER   ; a breather before the next wave
LDA #RESPAWN_SAFE
STA INVULN
; Fill the OPTION trail with the new position.
LDX #$1F
FillTrail:
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TRAIL_XL,X
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TRAIL_XH,X
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TRAIL_Y,X
DEX
BPL FillTrail
RTS

nodes.title: JOYSTICK / FIRE
code:
JOYSTICK / FIRE
Port 2. The JOYSTICK macro
calls a Joy... label per
direction; diagonals call
two. Fire launches every
free weapon.

nodes.title: INPUT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - INPUT
; State: SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM SPEEDUPS
;
; Input - the JOYSTICK macro below reads port 2 into $F8 and calls
; one of the Joy... labels for the direction held.
; Ship speed in pixels per frame - on the SHIP panel.
SHIP_SPEED = 2

Input:
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ InputAlive
RTS
InputAlive:
; This frame's step = SHIP_SPEED + SPEED power-ups taken.
LDA #SHIP_SPEED
CLC
ADC SPEEDUPS
STA SHIP_STEP
LDA #$00
STA SHIP_TILT

nodes.title: FIRE
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - FIRE
; State: FIRE_LATCH
;
; Fire. Hold fire for auto-fire, or tap mode: one press, one shot.
AUTO_FIRE = 1     ; on the SHIP panel

LDA $F8           ; joystick bits from the JOYSTICK macro, 0 = pressed
AND #$10
BNE FireReleased
.IF AUTO_FIRE == 0
LDA FIRE_LATCH
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA FIRE_LATCH
.ENDIF
JMP FireWeapons   ; launches whatever is free (WEAPONS column)
FireReleased:
LDA #$00
STA FIRE_LATCH
InputDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE LEFT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE LEFT
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH SHIP_STEP
;
; Left, as far as X_MIN. X is 9 bits: PLAYER_XL + PLAYER_XH.
X_MIN = $18

LDA PLAYER_XL
SEC
SBC SHIP_STEP
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
SBC #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
BMI JoyLeftClamp
BNE JoyLeftDone
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP #X_MIN
BCS JoyLeftDone
JoyLeftClamp:
LDA #X_MIN
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
JoyLeftDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE RIGHT
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE RIGHT
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH SHIP_STEP
;
; Right, as far as $100 + X_MAX_LO (a little short of the edge,
; so enemies arriving from the right can be seen).
X_MAX_LO = $20

LDA PLAYER_XL
CLC
ADC SHIP_STEP
STA PLAYER_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA PLAYER_XH
BEQ JoyRightDone
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP #X_MAX_LO
BCC JoyRightDone
LDA #X_MAX_LO
STA PLAYER_XL
JoyRightDone:
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE UP
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE UP
; State: PLAYER_Y SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT
;
; Up, no higher than Y_MIN (just under the HUD). Tilts the ship.
Y_MIN = $50

LDA #$01
STA SHIP_TILT
LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC SHIP_STEP
CMP #Y_MIN
BCS JoyUpStore
LDA #Y_MIN
JoyUpStore:
STA PLAYER_Y
RTS

nodes.title: MOVE DOWN
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE - MOVE DOWN
; State: PLAYER_Y SHIP_STEP SHIP_TILT
;
; Down, no lower than Y_MAX (the bottom of the screen).
Y_MAX = $DE

LDA #$02
STA SHIP_TILT
LDA PLAYER_Y
CLC
ADC SHIP_STEP
CMP #Y_MAX
BCC JoyDownStore
LDA #Y_MAX
JoyDownStore:
STA PLAYER_Y
RTS

nodes.title: Fire + direction rows are
code:
Fire + direction rows are
off, so fire never blocks
movement: the FIRE block
reads fire after the move.

nodes.title: Diagonals: one JSR for the
code:
Diagonals: one JSR for the
side step, then JMP to the
up/down routine, whose RTS
returns to the macro.

nodes.title: X is 9 bits: the screen is
code:
X is 9 bits: the screen is
320 pixels wide, a byte
only reaches 255. Each
move clamps to the edges
(X_MIN, X_MAX_LO, Y_MIN,
Y_MAX).
nodes.custom_title: X is 9 bits: the screen is

nodes.title: POWER METER
code:
POWER METER
Capsules light the next
meter slot. The power key
buys the lit one:
SPEED MISSL DOUBL LASER
OPTN SHLD.

nodes.title: POWER KEY
code:
; POWER METER - POWER KEY
; State: KEY_LATCH
;
; PowerKey - the key that cashes in the lit meter slot.
POWER_KEY = 0      ; on the POWER METER panel: 0 SPACE, 1 RETURN, 2 C=

.IF POWER_KEY == 0
KEY_ROW = $7F
KEY_BIT = $10
.ENDIF
.IF POWER_KEY == 1
KEY_ROW = $FE
KEY_BIT = $02
.ENDIF
.IF POWER_KEY == 2
KEY_ROW = $7F
KEY_BIT = $20
.ENDIF

PowerKey:
LDA #$FF
STA $DC02        ; port A drives the keyboard rows for a moment
LDA #KEY_ROW
STA $DC00
LDA $DC01        ; the row's keys, 0 = pressed
LDX #$FF
STX $DC00
LDX #$00
STX $DC02        ; port A back to input for the joystick
AND #KEY_BIT
BNE KeyUp
LDA KEY_LATCH    ; one power per press
BNE KeyDone
LDA #$01
STA KEY_LATCH
JMP ApplyPower
KeyUp:
LDA #$00
STA KEY_LATCH
KeyDone:
RTS

nodes.title: APPLY POWER
code:
; POWER METER - APPLY POWER
; State: METER SPEEDUPS HAS_MISSILE HAS_DOUBLE HAS_LASER
;        HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; ApplyPower - turn the lit slot into its power-up.
; Slots: 1 SPEED  2 MISSILE  3 DOUBLE  4 LASER  5 OPTION  6 SHIELD
; A power you already own is refused and the slot stays lit.
; On the POWER METER panel:
MAX_SPEEDUPS = 3   ; SPEED can be taken this many times
SHIELD_HITS = 3    ; hits a SHIELD soaks up

ApplyPower:
LDA METER
BNE PowerPick
RTS
PowerPick:
CMP #$01
BEQ PowSpeed
CMP #$02
BEQ PowMissile
CMP #$03
BEQ PowDouble
CMP #$04
BEQ PowLaser
CMP #$05
BEQ PowOption
; 6 = SHIELD, always refills
LDA #SHIELD_HITS
STA SHIELD
JMP PowerTaken

PowSpeed:
LDA SPEEDUPS
CMP #MAX_SPEEDUPS
BCS PowerRefused
INC SPEEDUPS
JMP PowerTaken

PowMissile:
LDA HAS_MISSILE
BNE PowerRefused
INC HAS_MISSILE
JMP PowerTaken

; DOUBLE and LASER replace each other.
PowDouble:
LDA HAS_DOUBLE
BNE PowerRefused
LDA #$01
STA HAS_DOUBLE
LDA #$00
STA HAS_LASER
JMP PowerTaken

PowLaser:
LDA HAS_LASER
BNE PowerRefused
LDA #$01
STA HAS_LASER
LDA #$00
STA HAS_DOUBLE
JMP PowerTaken

PowOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BNE PowerRefused
INC HAS_OPTION

PowerTaken:
LDA #$00
STA METER
JMP PowerSound
PowerRefused:
RTS

nodes.title: CAPSULE
code:
; POWER METER - CAPSULE
; State: PLAYER_BOOM EN_BOOM CAP_ON CAP_SLOT CAP_XL CAP_XH CAP_Y
;        METER BOX_XL BOX_XH BOX_Y BOX_W BOX_H
;
; Capsule - dropped by the last enemy of a wave (see KillEnemy).
; It borrows that enemy slot's sprite, drifts left with the world
; (ScrollStep) and lights the next meter slot when you fly into it.
Capsule:
LDA CAP_ON
BNE CapsuleLive
RTS
CapsuleLive:
; gone off the left edge?
LDA CAP_XH
BNE CapsuleShown
LDA CAP_XL
CMP #$10
BCS CapsuleShown
LDA #$00
STA CAP_ON
RTS
; still hidden behind its enemy's explosion?
CapsuleShown:
LDY CAP_SLOT
LDA EN_BOOM,Y
ORA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE CapsuleDone
LDA CAP_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA CAP_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA CAP_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$10
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsShip
BCS CapsuleDone
; collected: light the next slot, 6 wraps round to 1
LDA #$00
STA CAP_ON
INC METER
LDA METER
CMP #$07
BCC CapsuleGot
LDA #$01
STA METER
CapsuleGot:
JMP CapsuleSound
CapsuleDone:
RTS

nodes.title: The keyboard shares CIA 1
code:
The keyboard shares CIA 1
with the joystick: the row
is selected for one read,
then port A goes back to
input for the stick.

nodes.title: A capsule borrows a free
code:
A capsule borrows a free
enemy sprite (5-7), so the
wave launcher skips that
slot until it is picked up
or scrolls away.

nodes.title: ATTACK WAVES
code:
ATTACK WAVES
Read WAVE_SCRIPT, launch
enemies from the right,
fly them left on a path:
straight, sine, chase or
zigzag.

nodes.title: ENEMY FLIGHT
code:
; ATTACK WAVES - ENEMY FLIGHT
; State: PLAYER_Y ANIM EN_ON EN_XL EN_XH EN_Y EN_BASEY EN_PATH
;        EN_PHASE
;
; Enemy - launch from WAVE_SCRIPT, then fly the three enemy slots.
; On the ENEMIES panel:
ENEMY_SPEED = 2   ; pixels left per frame: 1 slow, 2 normal, 3 fast
WAVE_PAUSE = $50  ; frames between the end of a wave and the next

Enemy:
INC ANIM
JSR WaveSpawn
LDX #$02
EnemyLoop:
LDA EN_ON,X
BNE EnemyFly
JMP EnemyNext

; Every enemy flies left; off the left edge it is gone.
EnemyFly:
LDA EN_XL,X
SEC
SBC #ENEMY_SPEED
STA EN_XL,X
LDA EN_XH,X
SBC #$00
STA EN_XH,X
BNE EnemyPath
LDA EN_XL,X
CMP #$08
BCS EnemyPath
LDA #$00
STA EN_ON,X
JMP EnemyNext

; Up and down by path: 0 straight, 1 sine, 2 chase, 3 zigzag.
EnemyPath:
INC EN_PHASE,X
LDA EN_PATH,X
BEQ EnemyStraight
CMP #$01
BEQ EnemySine
CMP #$02
BEQ EnemyChase

; 3 ZIGZAG: a triangle wave, 32 pixels each side of the start.
LDA EN_PHASE,X
AND #$3F
CMP #$20
BCC ZigRising
EOR #$3F
ZigRising:
ASL
SEC
SBC #$20
CLC
ADC EN_BASEY,X
JMP EnemyStoreY

; 0 STRAIGHT: the height never changes.
EnemyStraight:
JMP EnemyNext

; 1 SINE: start Y + SINE_PATH ($B100, 128 signed bytes).
; Every enemy of a wave starts at phase 0, so they snake in a line.
EnemySine:
LDA EN_PHASE,X
ASL
AND #$7F
TAY
LDA $B100,Y
CLC
ADC EN_BASEY,X
JMP EnemyStoreY

; 2 CHASE: one pixel towards the ship's height every other frame.
EnemyChase:
LDA EN_PHASE,X
AND #$01
BNE ChaseStep
JMP EnemyNext
ChaseStep:
LDA EN_Y,X
CMP PLAYER_Y
BEQ EnemyNext
BCC ChaseDown
DEC EN_Y,X
JMP EnemyNext
ChaseDown:
INC EN_Y,X
JMP EnemyNext

EnemyStoreY:
STA EN_Y,X
EnemyNext:
DEX
BMI EnemyDone
JMP EnemyLoop
EnemyDone:
RTS

nodes.title: WAVE LAUNCHER
code:
; ATTACK WAVES - WAVE LAUNCHER
; State: WAVE_IDX WAVE_LEFT WAVE_TIMER WAVE_PATH WAVE_Y WAVE_GAP
;        WAVE_FRAME WAVE_COL EN_ON EN_XL EN_XH EN_Y EN_BASEY
;        EN_PATH EN_PHASE EN_FRAME EN_COL EN_BOOM EN_LAST CAP_ON
;        CAP_SLOT T0
;
; WaveSpawn - WAVE_SCRIPT ($B000) is 8 waves of 6 bytes:
;   path, start Y, enemies in the wave, frames between them,
;   first ACTORS frame (two-frame animation), colour
WaveSpawn:
LDA WAVE_TIMER
BEQ WaveReady
DEC WAVE_TIMER
RTS
WaveReady:
LDA WAVE_LEFT
BNE WaveFindSlot
; Start the next wave: its record is at WAVE_IDX * 6.
LDA WAVE_IDX
ASL
STA T0
ASL
CLC
ADC T0
TAY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_PATH
INY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_Y
INY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_LEFT
INY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_GAP
INY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_FRAME
INY
LDA $B000,Y
STA WAVE_COL
INC WAVE_IDX
LDA WAVE_IDX
AND #$07
STA WAVE_IDX

; A slot is free when it is not flying, not exploding and not
; lending its sprite to the capsule.
WaveFindSlot:
LDX #$02
WaveSlot:
LDA EN_ON,X
ORA EN_BOOM,X
BNE WaveSlotBusy
LDA CAP_ON
BEQ WaveLaunch
CPX CAP_SLOT
BNE WaveLaunch
WaveSlotBusy:
DEX
BPL WaveSlot
RTS              ; all busy - try again next frame

; Launch at X = $158, just past the right edge.
WaveLaunch:
LDA #$58
STA EN_XL,X
LDA #$01
STA EN_XH,X
LDA WAVE_Y
STA EN_Y,X
STA EN_BASEY,X
LDA WAVE_PATH
STA EN_PATH,X
LDA WAVE_FRAME
STA EN_FRAME,X
LDA WAVE_COL
STA EN_COL,X
LDA #$00
STA EN_PHASE,X
STA EN_LAST,X
LDA #$01
STA EN_ON,X
LDA WAVE_GAP
STA WAVE_TIMER
DEC WAVE_LEFT
BNE WaveLaunched
; The wave's last enemy carries a capsule; then a pause.
LDA #$01
STA EN_LAST,X
LDA #WAVE_PAUSE
STA WAVE_TIMER
WaveLaunched:
RTS

nodes.title: ASSET: SINE_PATH ($B100)
code:
ASSET: SINE_PATH ($B100)
128 signed offsets for the
sine path. Edit the bytes
to change the swing.

nodes.title: ASSET: WAVE_SCRIPT ($B000)
code:
ASSET: WAVE_SCRIPT ($B000)
8 waves x 6 bytes:
path 0-3, start Y, count,
gap (frames), first ACTORS
frame, colour.
Frames: 10 fan, 12 jet,
14 ring, 16 dart.

nodes.title: WEAPONS
code:
WEAPONS
Shot or LASER, DOUBLE,
MISSILE and the OPTION.
Shots stop at rock and
blow up hatches.

nodes.title: FIRE WEAPONS
code:
; WEAPONS - FIRE WEAPONS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH
;        SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH
;        MSL_Y HAS_MISSILE HAS_DOUBLE
;
; FireWeapons - fire pressed: launch every weapon that is free.
FireWeapons:
LDA SHOT_ON
BNE FireDouble
LDA #$01
STA SHOT_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL      ; from the ship's nose
CLC
ADC #$10
STA SHOT_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA SHOT_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA SHOT_Y
JSR FireSound

FireDouble:
LDA HAS_DOUBLE
BEQ FireMissile
LDA DBL_ON
BNE FireMissile
LDA #$01
STA DBL_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL
CLC
ADC #$08
STA DBL_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA DBL_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
SEC
SBC #$06
STA DBL_Y

FireMissile:
LDA HAS_MISSILE
BEQ FireDone
LDA MSL_ON
BNE FireDone
LDA #$01
STA MSL_ON
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA MSL_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA MSL_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
CLC
ADC #$06
STA MSL_Y
FireDone:
RTS

nodes.title: SHOT + DOUBLE
code:
; WEAPONS - SHOT + DOUBLE
; State: SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH
;        DBL_Y PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y HAS_LASER
;
; Weapons - move everything the ship has fired.
; Speeds in pixels per frame - on the WEAPONS panel.
SHOT_SPEED = 6
LASER_SPEED = 9
DOUBLE_SPEED = 4

Weapons:
JSR MoveShot
JSR MoveDouble
JMP MoveMissile

; The shot (or laser) flies right until the edge or the scenery.
MoveShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BNE ShotLive
RTS
ShotLive:
LDA #SHOT_SPEED
LDY HAS_LASER
BEQ ShotStep
LDA #LASER_SPEED
ShotStep:
CLC
ADC SHOT_XL
STA SHOT_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
ADC #$00
STA SHOT_XH
BEQ ShotTerrain
LDA SHOT_XL
CMP #$50
BCC ShotTerrain
ShotGone:
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
RTS
; Probe the scenery at the tip of the shot.
ShotTerrain:
LDA SHOT_XL
CLC
ADC #$10
STA PROBE_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
CLC
ADC #$09
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS ShotGone
RTS

; DOUBLE flies up and right at 45 degrees.
MoveDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BNE DoubleLive
RTS
DoubleLive:
LDA DBL_XL
CLC
ADC #DOUBLE_SPEED
STA DBL_XL
LDA DBL_XH
ADC #$00
STA DBL_XH
BEQ DoubleUp
LDA DBL_XL
CMP #$50
BCS DoubleGone
DoubleUp:
LDA DBL_Y
SEC
SBC #DOUBLE_SPEED
STA DBL_Y
CMP #$40
BCC DoubleGone
LDA DBL_XL
CLC
ADC #$0C
STA PROBE_XL
LDA DBL_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA DBL_Y
CLC
ADC #$09
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS DoubleGone
RTS
DoubleGone:
LDA #$00
STA DBL_ON
RTS

nodes.title: MISSILE
code:
; WEAPONS - MISSILE
; State: MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y
;
; MISSILE drops until it meets the ground, then runs along it.
MISSILE_SPEED = 3   ; on the WEAPONS panel

MoveMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BNE MissileLive
RTS
MissileLive:
LDA MSL_XL
CLC
ADC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_XL
LDA MSL_XH
ADC #$00
STA MSL_XH
BEQ MissileGround
LDA MSL_XL
CMP #$50
BCS MissileGone
; Anything just underneath?
MissileGround:
LDA MSL_XL
CLC
ADC #$0C
STA PROBE_XL
LDA MSL_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA MSL_Y
CLC
ADC #$0E
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
CMP #$00
BNE MissileLanded
; Nothing: keep falling.
LDA MSL_Y
CLC
ADC #MISSILE_SPEED
STA MSL_Y
CMP #$E8
BCS MissileGone
RTS
; On the ground: a hatch underneath is blown up, rock is followed.
MissileLanded:
JSR GroundHit
BCS MissileGone
; Running into a wall ends it.
MissileAhead:
LDA MSL_XL
CLC
ADC #$12
STA PROBE_XL
LDA MSL_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
LDA MSL_Y
CLC
ADC #$0A
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
JSR TerrainHit
BCS MissileGone
RTS
MissileGone:
LDA #$00
STA MSL_ON
RTS

nodes.title: OPTION
code:
; WEAPONS - OPTION
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y OPT_XL OPT_XH OPT_Y
;        TRAIL_POS TRAIL_XL TRAIL_XH TRAIL_Y
;
; OPTION - an orb that follows the ship's path OPTION_GAP moves
; behind. It destroys any enemy it touches (Hits). A C64 has eight
; sprites and every one is in use, so this OPTION rams instead of
; firing - free a sprite to give it a shot of its own.
OPTION_GAP = 12    ; on the WEAPONS panel, 4-30

; The trail is 32 positions; a new one is stored only when the
; ship moves, so a still ship keeps its OPTION where it is.
OptionMove:
LDY TRAIL_POS
LDA PLAYER_XL
CMP TRAIL_XL,Y
BNE TrailPush
LDA PLAYER_Y
CMP TRAIL_Y,Y
BEQ TrailRead
TrailPush:
INY
TYA
AND #$1F
STA TRAIL_POS
TAY
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TRAIL_XL,Y
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TRAIL_XH,Y
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TRAIL_Y,Y
TrailRead:
LDA TRAIL_POS
SEC
SBC #OPTION_GAP
AND #$1F
TAY
LDA TRAIL_XL,Y
STA OPT_XL
LDA TRAIL_XH,Y
STA OPT_XH
LDA TRAIL_Y,Y
STA OPT_Y
RTS

nodes.title: Each weapon asks ProbeChar
code:
Each weapon asks ProbeChar
(COLLISIONS) what char is
at its tip, then
TerrainHit decides: rock
stops it, a hatch is
blown up.

nodes.title: All 8 sprites are in use,
code:
All 8 sprites are in use,
so the OPTION rams enemies
instead of shooting.

nodes.title: COLLISIONS / LIVES
code:
COLLISIONS / LIVES
Ship vs rock and enemies,
weapons vs enemies, score,
shield and lives.

nodes.title: HITS
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - HITS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y PLAYER_BOOM INVULN LIVES
;        SCORE1 SCORE2 EN_ON EN_XL EN_XH EN_Y EN_BOOM EN_LAST
;        SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON DBL_XL DBL_XH
;        DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y OPT_XL OPT_XH OPT_Y
;        CAP_ON CAP_SLOT CAP_XL CAP_XH CAP_Y BOX_XL BOX_XH BOX_Y
;        BOX_W BOX_H HAS_LASER HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; Hits - the ship against walls and enemies, and every weapon
; against every enemy. On the RULES panel:
WALLS_KILL = 1     ; 1 = flying into the scenery costs a ship
DROPS = 1          ; 1 = the last enemy of a wave drops a capsule
ENEMY_POINTS = 1   ; score per enemy, in hundreds (BCD, 1-9)

Hits:
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ HitsAlive
RTS
HitsAlive:
LDA INVULN
BEQ HitsWalls
DEC INVULN
JMP HitsEnemies
HitsWalls:
.IF WALLS_KILL == 1
JSR ShipVsTerrain
BCC HitsEnemies
JSR ShipHit
.ENDIF

HitsEnemies:
LDX #$02
HitLoop:
LDA EN_ON,X
BNE HitShip
JMP HitNext

; the ship (skipped while invulnerable)
HitShip:
LDA INVULN
ORA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE HitShot
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_W
LDA #$0A
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitShot
JSR KillEnemy
JSR ShipHit
JMP HitNext

; the shot - a LASER keeps going through
HitShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BEQ HitDouble
LDA SHOT_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_W
LDA #$09
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitDouble
LDA HAS_LASER
BNE HitShotKill
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
HitShotKill:
JSR KillEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BEQ HitMissile
LDA DBL_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA DBL_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA DBL_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitMissile
LDA #$00
STA DBL_ON
JSR KillEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BEQ HitOption
LDA MSL_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA MSL_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA MSL_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_W
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitOption
LDA #$00
STA MSL_ON
JSR KillEnemy
JMP HitNext

HitOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BEQ HitNext
LDA OPT_XL
STA BOX_XL
LDA OPT_XH
STA BOX_XH
LDA OPT_Y
STA BOX_Y
LDA #$0E
STA BOX_W
LDA #$0C
STA BOX_H
JSR BoxVsEnemy
BCS HitNext
JSR KillEnemy

HitNext:
DEX
BMI HitsDone
JMP HitLoop
HitsDone:
RTS

; KillEnemy - X = slot. Explosion, points, maybe a capsule.
KillEnemy:
LDA #$00
STA EN_ON,X
LDA #$18
STA EN_BOOM,X
LDA #ENEMY_POINTS
JSR AddScore
JSR ExplosionSound
.IF DROPS == 1
LDA EN_LAST,X
BEQ KillDone
LDA CAP_ON
BNE KillDone
LDA #$01
STA CAP_ON
STX CAP_SLOT
LDA EN_XL,X
STA CAP_XL
LDA EN_XH,X
STA CAP_XH
LDA EN_Y,X
STA CAP_Y
.ENDIF
KillDone:
RTS

; ShipHit - a SHIELD soaks the hit, otherwise the ship bursts.
ShipHit:
LDA SHIELD
BEQ ShipBurst
DEC SHIELD
LDA #$30
STA INVULN
JMP ExplosionSound
ShipBurst:
LDA #$20
STA PLAYER_BOOM
LDA #$00
STA SHOT_ON
STA DBL_ON
STA MSL_ON
DEC LIVES
JMP ExplosionSound

; AddScore - A = points in hundreds (BCD).
AddScore:
SED
CLC
ADC SCORE1
STA SCORE1
LDA SCORE2
ADC #$00
STA SCORE2
CLD
RTS

nodes.title: TERRAIN
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - TERRAIN
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y
;
; The scenery. Chars are tagged in the TILES charset (char editor:
; right-click a char to set its tag). The WORLD SCROLLER emits
; the tags as WORLD_TILE_TYPES. On the RULES panel:
WALL_TAG = 1        ; rock: stops shots, wrecks the ship
TARGET_TAG = 2      ; ground hatches: shots blow them up
TARGET_POINTS = 3   ; score for a hatch, in hundreds (BCD)

; TILES chars the hatches are made of, and their wreckage.
CH_HATCH_L = 108
CH_HATCH_R = 109
CH_CHATCH_L = 110
CH_CHATCH_R = 111
CH_RUBBLE = 112
CH_CRUBBLE = 113

; TerrainHit - A = tag from ProbeChar.
; Out: carry set = the weapon is stopped (a hatch is blown up too).
TerrainHit:
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ TerrainStop
CMP #TARGET_TAG
BEQ TerrainTarget
CLC
RTS
TerrainTarget:
JSR BlastTarget
TerrainStop:
SEC
RTS

; GroundHit - like TerrainHit, but rock underneath is fine (the
; MISSILE runs along it). Carry set = a hatch was blown up.
GroundHit:
CMP #TARGET_TAG
BNE GroundRock
JSR BlastTarget
SEC
RTS
GroundRock:
CLC
RTS

; BlastTarget - ($FB) is a hatch char: swap both halves for rubble.
BlastTarget:
LDY #$00
LDA ($FB),Y
CMP #CH_HATCH_R
BEQ BlastStepBack
CMP #CH_CHATCH_R
BNE BlastPair
BlastStepBack:
LDA $FB          ; right half hit: step back to the left half
BNE BlastDecLo
DEC $FC
BlastDecLo:
DEC $FB
BlastPair:
LDA ($FB),Y
CMP #CH_HATCH_L
BEQ BlastFloor
LDA #CH_CRUBBLE
STA ($FB),Y
INY
STA ($FB),Y
JMP BlastScore
BlastFloor:
LDA #CH_RUBBLE
STA ($FB),Y
INY
STA ($FB),Y
BlastScore:
LDA #TARGET_POINTS
JSR AddScore
JMP ExplosionSound

; ShipVsTerrain - carry set when the nose or a wing tip is in rock.
ShipVsTerrain:
LDA #$17
LDY #$09
JSR ShipProbe
BCS ShipTerrainDone
LDA #$06
LDY #$04
JSR ShipProbe
BCS ShipTerrainDone
LDA #$06
LDY #$10
JSR ShipProbe
ShipTerrainDone:
RTS

; ShipProbe - A / Y = x / y offset into the ship sprite.
ShipProbe:
CLC
ADC PLAYER_XL
STA PROBE_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
ADC #$00
STA PROBE_XH
TYA
CLC
ADC PLAYER_Y
STA PROBE_Y
JSR ProbeChar
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ ShipSolid
CMP #TARGET_TAG
BEQ ShipSolid
CLC
RTS
ShipSolid:
SEC
RTS

nodes.title: BOX TEST
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - BOX TEST
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y EN_XL EN_XH EN_Y BOX_XL
;        BOX_XH BOX_Y BOX_W BOX_H TGT_XL TGT_XH TGT_Y T0 T1
;
; BoxTest - do two sprites overlap?
;  In: BOX_XL/BOX_XH/BOX_Y  one sprite's position
;      TGT_XL/TGT_XH/TGT_Y  the other's (BoxVsShip / BoxVsEnemy set it)
;      BOX_W / BOX_H        how close counts as touching, in pixels
; Out: carry clear = touching. X and Y are kept.
; Every ACTORS frame is drawn centred, so comparing the sprites'
; corners compares their middles.
BoxVsShip:
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA TGT_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA TGT_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA TGT_Y
JMP BoxTest

BoxVsEnemy:
LDA EN_XL,X
STA TGT_XL
LDA EN_XH,X
STA TGT_XH
LDA EN_Y,X
STA TGT_Y

BoxTest:
LDA BOX_XL
SEC
SBC TGT_XL
STA T0
LDA BOX_XH
SBC TGT_XH
STA T1           ; T1:T0 = distance in X, signed
LDA T0
CLC
ADC BOX_W
STA T0
LDA T1
ADC #$00
BNE BoxMiss      ; more than 255 apart, either way
LDA BOX_W
ASL
STA T1
LDA T0
CMP T1
BCS BoxMiss
LDA BOX_Y
SEC
SBC TGT_Y
CLC
ADC BOX_H
STA T0
LDA BOX_H
ASL
STA T1
LDA T0
CMP T1
BCS BoxMiss
CLC
RTS
BoxMiss:
SEC
RTS

nodes.title: PROBE CHAR
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES - PROBE CHAR
; State: PROBE_XL PROBE_XH PROBE_Y PROBE_COL PROBE_CHAR T0 T1
;
; ProbeChar - which char is under a point, and what is its tag?
;  In: PROBE_XL/PROBE_XH/PROBE_Y, a point in sprite coordinates.
; Out: A = the char's tag (0 = untagged, off screen or in the HUD),
;      $FB/$FC + Y=0 = the char on the screen.
; $62 / $63 are the WORLD SCROLLER's fine X / fine Y.
ProbeNone:
LDA #$00
RTS

ProbeChar:
; column = (X - 24 - fine X) / 8
LDA PROBE_XL
SEC
SBC #$18
STA T0
LDA PROBE_XH
SBC #$00
STA T1
LDA T0
SEC
SBC $62
STA T0
LDA T1
SBC #$00
BMI ProbeNone
LSR
ROR T0
LSR
ROR T0
LSR
ROR T0
LDA T0
CMP #$27
BCS ProbeNone
STA PROBE_COL
; row = (Y - 48 - fine Y) / 8. Rows 0-2 are the HUD.
LDA PROBE_Y
SEC
SBC #$30
BCC ProbeNone
SEC
SBC $63
BCC ProbeNone
LSR
LSR
LSR
CMP #$03
BCC ProbeNone
CMP #$19
BCS ProbeNone
; $FB/$FC = $0400 + row * 40 + column
TAY
LDA ProbeRowLo,Y
CLC
ADC PROBE_COL
STA $FB
LDA ProbeRowHi,Y
ADC #$00
STA $FC
LDY #$00
LDA ($FB),Y
STA PROBE_CHAR
; Look it up in WORLD_TILE_TYPES: [char, tag] pairs, $FF ends.
ProbeScan:
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
CMP #$FF
BEQ ProbeNone
CMP PROBE_CHAR
BEQ ProbeTag
INY
INY
BNE ProbeScan
JMP ProbeNone
ProbeTag:
INY
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
RTS

ProbeRowLo:
.byte $00,$28,$50,$78,$A0,$C8,$F0,$18,$40,$68,$90,$B8,$E0,$08,$30,$58,$80,$A8,$D0,$F8,$20,$48,$70,$98,$C0
ProbeRowHi:
.byte $04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$04,$05,$05,$05,$05,$05,$05,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$06,$07,$07,$07,$07,$07

nodes.title: Tags come from TILES: rock
code:
Tags come from TILES: rock
chars are T1, hatch chars
T2. Tag new chars the same
way and they just work.

nodes.title: ProbeChar reads the char
code:
ProbeChar reads the char
under a point straight off
the screen, so a blown-up
hatch stays rubble until
the level loops round.

nodes.title: SPRITE DRAW
code:
SPRITE DRAW
Game state into the VIC:
positions (9-bit X),
frames, colours, blinking
and explosions.

nodes.title: DRAW ACTORS
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - DRAW ACTORS
; State: PLAYER_XL PLAYER_XH PLAYER_Y SHIP_TILT PLAYER_BOOM
;        INVULN ANIM SHOT_ON SHOT_XL SHOT_XH SHOT_Y DBL_ON
;        DBL_XL DBL_XH DBL_Y MSL_ON MSL_XL MSL_XH MSL_Y OPT_XL
;        OPT_XH OPT_Y D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB
;        HAS_LASER HAS_OPTION SHIELD
;
; DrawActors - copy the game state into the VIC sprite registers.
; Sprites: 0 ship, 1 shot/laser, 2 DOUBLE, 3 MISSILE, 4 OPTION,
; 5-7 the three enemy slots (or the capsule, in a free slot).
; Colours - on the COLOURS panel (enemy colours are in WAVE_SCRIPT).
SHIP_COL = 1
SHIELD_COL = 14
SHOT_COL = 7
LASER_COL = 3
MISSILE_COL = 10
OPTION_COL = 8
CAPSULE_COL = 2
BOOM_COL = 7

; ACTORS frames as sprite pointers ($2800 / 64 = $A0 is frame 0).
FR_BASE = $A0
FR_SHIP = $A0
FR_SHIP_FLAME = $A1   ; +1 climb, +2 dive
FR_SHOT = $A4
FR_LASER = $A5
FR_DOUBLE = $A6
FR_MISSILE = $A7
FR_OPTION = $A8
FR_CAPSULE = $B2
FR_BOOM = $B4

DrawActors:
LDA #$00
STA SPR_ON
STA SPR_MSB

; --- sprite 0: the ship ---
LDA PLAYER_XL
STA D_XL
LDA PLAYER_XH
STA D_XH
LDA PLAYER_Y
STA D_Y
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ ShipFlying
JSR BoomFrame
JMP ShipPut
ShipFlying:
LDA INVULN          ; blink while it cannot be hit
AND #$04
BNE DrawShot
LDA SHIP_TILT
BEQ ShipLevel
CLC
ADC #FR_SHIP_FLAME
STA D_PTR
JMP ShipColour
ShipLevel:
LDA ANIM            ; exhaust flicker
AND #$02
LSR
CLC
ADC #FR_SHIP
STA D_PTR
ShipColour:
LDA #SHIP_COL
LDY SHIELD
BEQ ShipColourSet
LDA #SHIELD_COL
ShipColourSet:
STA D_COL
ShipPut:
LDX #$00
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 1: shot or laser ---
DrawShot:
LDA SHOT_ON
BEQ DrawDouble
LDA SHOT_XL
STA D_XL
LDA SHOT_XH
STA D_XH
LDA SHOT_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_SHOT
LDY #SHOT_COL
LDX HAS_LASER
BEQ ShotLook
LDA #FR_LASER
LDY #LASER_COL
ShotLook:
STA D_PTR
STY D_COL
LDX #$01
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 2: DOUBLE ---
DrawDouble:
LDA DBL_ON
BEQ DrawMissile
LDA DBL_XL
STA D_XL
LDA DBL_XH
STA D_XH
LDA DBL_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_DOUBLE
STA D_PTR
LDA #SHOT_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$02
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 3: MISSILE ---
DrawMissile:
LDA MSL_ON
BEQ DrawOption
LDA MSL_XL
STA D_XL
LDA MSL_XH
STA D_XH
LDA MSL_Y
STA D_Y
LDA #FR_MISSILE
STA D_PTR
LDA #MISSILE_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$03
JSR PutSprite

; --- sprite 4: OPTION ---
DrawOption:
LDA HAS_OPTION
BEQ DrawEnemies
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BNE DrawEnemies
LDA OPT_XL
STA D_XL
LDA OPT_XH
STA D_XH
LDA OPT_Y
STA D_Y
LDA ANIM
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #FR_OPTION
STA D_PTR
LDA #OPTION_COL
STA D_COL
LDX #$04
JSR PutSprite

nodes.title: DRAW ENEMIES
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - DRAW ENEMIES
; State: ANIM EN_ON EN_XL EN_XH EN_Y EN_FRAME EN_COL EN_BOOM
;        CAP_ON CAP_SLOT CAP_XL CAP_XH CAP_Y D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR
;        D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB T2
;
; --- sprites 5-7: enemy slots 0-2 ---
DrawEnemies:
LDA #$02
STA T2
DrawEnemyLoop:
LDY T2
LDA EN_XL,Y
STA D_XL
LDA EN_XH,Y
STA D_XH
LDA EN_Y,Y
STA D_Y
LDA EN_BOOM,Y
BEQ DrawEnemyLive
JSR BoomFrame
JMP DrawEnemyPut
DrawEnemyLive:
LDA EN_ON,Y
BEQ DrawCapsule
LDA ANIM            ; two frames, swapped every 8 frames
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC EN_FRAME,Y
CLC
ADC #FR_BASE
STA D_PTR
LDA EN_COL,Y
STA D_COL
DrawEnemyPut:
LDA T2
CLC
ADC #$05
TAX
JSR PutSprite
JMP DrawEnemyNext

; A free slot may be lending its sprite to the capsule.
DrawCapsule:
LDA CAP_ON
BEQ DrawEnemyNext
CPY CAP_SLOT
BNE DrawEnemyNext
LDA CAP_XL
STA D_XL
LDA CAP_XH
STA D_XH
LDA CAP_Y
STA D_Y
LDA ANIM
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #FR_CAPSULE
STA D_PTR
LDA #CAPSULE_COL
STA D_COL
LDA ANIM            ; flash white
AND #$08
BEQ DrawEnemyPut
LDA #$01
STA D_COL
JMP DrawEnemyPut

DrawEnemyNext:
DEC T2
BMI DrawEnemiesDone
JMP DrawEnemyLoop
DrawEnemiesDone:

; All sprites placed: switch on exactly the ones in use.
LDA SPR_ON
STA $D015
LDA SPR_MSB
STA $D010
RTS

nodes.title: PUT SPRITE
code:
; SPRITE DRAW - PUT SPRITE
; State: D_XL D_XH D_Y D_PTR D_COL SPR_ON SPR_MSB
;
; PutSprite - sprite X (0-7) at D_XL/D_XH/D_Y, pointer D_PTR,
; colour D_COL; marks it in SPR_ON and the ninth-bit mask SPR_MSB.
PutSprite:
LDA D_PTR
STA $07F8,X
LDA D_COL
STA $D027,X
LDA SprBit,X
ORA SPR_ON
STA SPR_ON
LDA D_XH
BEQ PutLowX
LDA SprBit,X
ORA SPR_MSB
STA SPR_MSB
PutLowX:
TXA
ASL
TAY
LDA D_XL
STA $D000,Y
LDA D_Y
STA $D001,Y
RTS
SprBit:
.byte $01,$02,$04,$08,$10,$20,$40,$80

; BoomFrame - A = explosion timer -> one of the four BOOM frames.
BoomFrame:
LSR
LSR
LSR
CMP #$04
BCC BoomStep
LDA #$03
BoomStep:
EOR #$03          ; counts down, so big timer = first frame
CLC
ADC #FR_BOOM
STA D_PTR
LDA #BOOM_COL
STA D_COL
RTS

nodes.title: Enemy frame = its WAVE
code:
Enemy frame = its WAVE
frame + 0 or 1, swapped
every 8 frames, so enemy
frames come in pairs in
ACTORS.

nodes.title: Sprites past X = 255 need
code:
Sprites past X = 255 need
their bit in $D010. SPR_MSB
collects them, written
once at the end.

nodes.title: HUD VALUES
code:
HUD VALUES
Score, high score and
ships into the HUD, and
the meter slot colours.

nodes.title: STATUS
code:
; HUD VALUES - STATUS
; State: LIVES ANIM SCORE1 SCORE2 METER POWERS HI1 HI2
;
; Status - numbers and meter colours into the fixed HUD (rows 0-2,
; drawn by the TOP STATUS macro from the STATUS asset).
; Meter colours - on the HUD panel.
METER_COL = 14       ; a slot you can buy
METER_LIT_COL = 7    ; the lit slot (flashes white)
METER_OWNED_COL = 11 ; a power you already own

Status:
LDY #$07          ; score at row 0, column 7 (the HUD adds "00")
LDA SCORE2
JSR PutBcd
LDA SCORE1
JSR PutBcd
LDY #$14          ; high score at column 20
LDA HI2
JSR PutBcd
LDA HI1
JSR PutBcd
LDA LIVES         ; ships at column 37
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0425

; Meter word n is 5 cells of colour RAM at row 1, column 2 + 6n.
LDX #$00
LDY #$00
MeterLoop:
JSR MeterColour
STA $D82A,Y
STA $D82B,Y
STA $D82C,Y
STA $D82D,Y
STA $D82E,Y
TYA
CLC
ADC #$06
TAY
INX
CPX #$06
BNE MeterLoop
RTS

; MeterColour - A = colour for meter slot X (0-5).
MeterColour:
TXA
CLC
ADC #$01
CMP METER
BNE MeterNotLit
LDA ANIM
AND #$08
BEQ MeterLit
LDA #$01
RTS
MeterLit:
LDA #METER_LIT_COL
RTS
MeterNotLit:
CPX #$00          ; SPEED can be bought again
BEQ MeterNormal
LDA POWERS,X
BEQ MeterNormal
LDA #METER_OWNED_COL
RTS
MeterNormal:
LDA #METER_COL
RTS

; PutBcd - BCD byte A as two digits at $0400 + Y; Y moves on by 2.
PutBcd:
PHA
LSR
LSR
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0400,Y
INY
PLA
AND #$0F
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0400,Y
INY
RTS

nodes.title: FIXED HUD / RASTER
code:
FIXED HUD / RASTER
The IRQ callbacks: HUD
steady and hires, then
the scrolling multicolour
playfield.

nodes.title: HUD SPLIT
code:
; FIXED HUD / RASTER - HUD SPLIT
;
; The two raster IRQ callbacks (STARTUP column). The HUD rows are
; hires and 40 columns wide and never scroll; the playfield below
; is multicolour, 38 columns, with the WORLD SCROLLER's fine X ($62)
; and fine Y ($63).
HudFixed:
LDA #$1B          ; fine Y 3: HUD row 0 starts on the first visible line
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
RTS

HudPlayfield:
LDA $63
ORA #$10
STA $D011
LDA $62
ORA #$10
STA $D016
RTS

HudNmi:
RTI

nodes.title: EXPLOSIONS / SFX
code:
EXPLOSIONS / SFX
Sound effects on voice 3,
explosion timers, and
GAME OVER back to the
title.

nodes.title: SILENCE
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - SILENCE
;
; SilenceGame - quiet voices 1 and 2, then set up the SFX player.
SilenceGame:
LDA #$00
STA $D404
STA $D40B

nodes.title: EXPLOSION SOUND
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - EXPLOSION SOUND
;
RTS

; ExplosionSound keeps X (it is called from the enemy loops).
ExplosionSound:
TXA
PHA

nodes.title: CAPSULE SOUND
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - CAPSULE SOUND
;
PLA
TAX
RTS

CapsuleSound:

nodes.title: POWER SOUND
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - POWER SOUND
;
RTS

PowerSound:

nodes.title: SFX TICK
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - SFX TICK
;
RTS

; SfxTick - once per frame from GameLoop.
SfxTick:

nodes.title: EFFECTS + GAME OVER
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX - EFFECTS + GAME OVER
; State: PLAYER_BOOM LIVES SCORE1 SCORE2 EN_BOOM HI1 HI2
;
RTS

; Effects - run the explosion timers. When the ship's burst ends:
; another ship, or GAME OVER back to the title.
Effects:
LDX #$02
EffectEnemy:
LDA EN_BOOM,X
BEQ EffectNext
DEC EN_BOOM,X
EffectNext:
DEX
BPL EffectEnemy
LDA PLAYER_BOOM
BEQ EffectsDone
DEC PLAYER_BOOM
BNE EffectsDone
LDA LIVES
BEQ GameOver
JMP ResetActors
EffectsDone:
RTS

; GameOver - keep the best score, then back to the title.
GameOver:
LDA SCORE2
CMP HI2
BCC GameOverTitle
BNE GameOverHi
LDA SCORE1
CMP HI1
BCC GameOverTitle
GameOverHi:
LDA SCORE2
STA HI2
LDA SCORE1
STA HI1
GameOverTitle:
SEI
LDA #$00
STA $D01A          ; raster IRQs off before the KERNAL comes back
STA $D015
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
JSR SilenceGame
JMP BootTitle

nodes.title: ASSET: GAME_SFX
code:
ASSET: GAME_SFX
0 LASER, 1 EXPLOSION,
2 CAPSULE, 3 POWER UP.
Each sound is a label, an
SFX macro and an RTS.
